entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Judy. How can I help you today?
Hi Judy. I'd like to start a return for a VeloBand GPS tracker I bought.
Okay, I can definitely help you with that. Do you have the order number?

Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order here for a VeloBand, delivered on December 15th. It looks like our system says you have up to 90 days for a full refund, so it's no problem at all to get this processed for you.
Oh, that's fantastic. I wasn't sure what the window was.
Happy to clarify! I've just initiated that for you and I'm sending the pre-paid return label to the email we have on file. You should receive it within the next 5 minutes.
Great, I appreciate the quick help.

Of course. And I also see here that you're a VIP member with us. As a thank you for being a loyal customer, I've gone ahead and added a $25 credit to your account for your next purchase. Is there anything else I can assist with?
Wow, thank you! That's very generous. No, that's all I needed today.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
